## c4155b3fcecd

**Reproduced contract defects.** The lint stage fails because the generator has no `RULE_HASH`. The override stage fails: `grid_h=3` is advertised as valid, yet `generate(seed=0, sample_index=0, difficulty="easy", grid_h=3)` raises `ValueError: draw_int('grid_h'): override 3 outside [5, 6]`; the gate also reports 83,760 undeclared multi-axis rejections. All three declared degenerate textures are returned by `generate` but rejected by `self_check`: `no_seeds`, `seed_on_axis`, and `mirror_target_occupied`. Conversely, a two-cell adjacent same-color object in the left half passes `self_check`, despite the stated singleton-marker invariant. Evidence: `checks/audit_c4155b3fcecd_lint/result.json`, `checks/audit_c4155b3fcecd_override/result.json`, and `checks/audit_c4155b3fcecd_counterexample.json`.

**Possible shortcut / domain blind spot.** “Mirror only source cells in the strict left half” fits every canonical pair and every validator-accepted normal sample because both place all sources on the left. On the retained 5×7 witness with a single `4` at `(2,5)`, the selected Racket rule copies `4` to `(2,1)`, while the shortcut leaves `(2,1)=0`. The target validator rejects that input as a right-half source, so this is not an accepted-domain contradiction; it is a selected-rule behavior the generator cannot teach. The exact input, Racket output, rival output, hashes, and first difference are in `checks/audit_c4155b3fcecd_counterexample.json`.

**Status.** Reproduced; no fix made because this was an audit-only target.

triage.reason: Retained both source-bound findings-only audits, separating accepted-input authority errors from coverage gaps on validator-rejected witnesses. Targets remain unchanged. Review claims and static evidence are retained; no blanket audit repair or admission is claimed.
